source.title: Three studies from Meta and AMI Labs back Yann LeCun's bet on JEPA world models over large language models
source.text: Yann LeCun is pushing forward with his alternative to language models through his startup AMI Labs. The JEPA architecture aims to give machines an internal world model that captures cause and effect. Three new studies show progress in robot planning, more efficient training, and error correction, though the pieces still need to grow together. The article Three studies from Meta and AMI Labs back Yann LeCun's bet on JEPA world models over large language models appeared first on The Decoder .

draft.instagram_caption:
Yann LeCun's startup AMI Labs is betting that "world models" will eventually replace language models. Three new studies from Meta and AMI Labs show how the JEPA architecture captures cause and effect. Researchers report progress in robot planning, training efficiency, and error correction. While the pieces still need to grow together, the goal is to give machines an internal model of the physical world. Should AI learn from language or by modeling physical cause and effect?
